name: Jaipur & Udaipur
tagline: Royal palaces, shimmering lakes, and living heritage of Rajasthan
description: The Land of Kings, showcasing fairy-tale fortresses, vibrant bazaars, royal Rajput architecture, and the regal City Palace beside Lake Pichola.

places.name: Amber Fort & Palace
places.description: Perched atop a rugged hill with stunning mirror mosaic palaces (Sheesh Mahal) and sweeping views over Maota Lake.

places.name: Lake Pichola & City Palace
places.description: A tranquil boat cruise along Udaipur's romantic waters, flanked by marble ghats and the historic white palace.

places.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
places.description: A five-storey pink sandstone façade with 953 ornate lattice windows designed for royal ladies to view city life.

name: Kerala Backwaters
tagline: God's Own Country, emerald canals, and Ayurvedic tranquility
description: A palm-fringed labyrinth of lagoons, lakes, and rivers where traditional kettuvallam houseboats glide through serene tropical waters.

places.name: Alleppey Houseboat Cruise
places.description: Sail along serene palm-canopied canals, observing village life, paddy fields, and spectacular sunsets.

places.name: Munnar Tea Plantations
places.description: Rolling hills blanketed in manicured tea gardens, cool mountain mist, and rare waterfalls in the Western Ghats.

name: Kyoto
tagline: Temples, gardens, and the quiet weight of centuries
description: Former imperial capital where tradition and modernity coexist in extraordinary harmony. Thousands of shrines, geisha districts, bamboo forests, and exquisite kaiseki cuisine.

places.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
places.description: Thousands of vermilion torii gates climb the mountainside in a mesmerizing tunnel, each donated by a Japanese business.

places.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
places.description: A towering canopy of bamboo that filters light into something otherworldly.

places.name: Gion District
places.description: Kyoto's most storied geisha district, lined with traditional ochaya teahouses.

name: Paris
tagline: Every arrondissement a world, every café a stage
description: The City of Light — Haussmann's boulevards and the Seine frame an unmatched collection of art, haute cuisine, and architecture.

places.name: Eiffel Tower
places.description: Gustave Eiffel's 1889 iron lattice masterpiece offering breathtaking views of the Paris skyline.

places.name: Musée du Louvre
places.description: The world's foremost art museum, home to the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory.

name: Santorini
tagline: White-washed cliffs and Aegean sunsets that stop time
description: A volcanic crescent in the Aegean Sea where caldera-edge villages cascade down sheer cliffs into the azure sea.

places.name: Oia Village
places.description: Iconic blue-domed churches and whitewashed windmills overlooking dramatic sunset caldera vistas.

name: Dubai
tagline: Futuristic skyline rising like a mirage above Arabian golden sands
description: A city of superlatives — home to the world's tallest skyscraper, palm-shaped artificial islands, desert safaris, and ultra-luxurious lifestyle.

places.name: Burj Khalifa
places.description: The world's tallest structure standing at 828m, featuring high-speed observation decks overlooking the Persian Gulf.

places.name: Arabian Desert Dune Safari
places.description: Dune bashing, camel riding, and traditional Bedouin dining under starry Arabian skies.

name: Rome
tagline: The Eternal City of gladiators, baroque fountains, and legendary pasta
description: Nearly three millennia of globally influential art, architecture, and culture on display across the Colosseum, Vatican, and cobbled piazzas.

places.name: The Colosseum
places.description: The largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, hosting gladiator battles in Imperial Rome.

places.name: Trevi Fountain
places.description: Baroque masterwork where travelers toss a coin to ensure their return to Rome.

name: Amalfi Coast
tagline: Lemon groves, pastel villages, and a sea that invented the color blue
description: A UNESCO-listed stretch of dramatic coastline where cliff-top villages like Positano and Ravello tumble down to turquoise coves.

places.name: Positano
places.description: A cascade of terracotta and pastel buildings clinging to the cliffside above turquoise Mediterranean water.

name: Barcelona
tagline: Gaudí’s surrealist wonderland, Mediterranean beaches, and tapas nights
description: The cosmopolitan capital of Catalonia, celebrated for Sagrada Família, Park Güell, gothic quarters, and lively beachside promenade.

places.name: Basílica de la Sagrada Família
places.description: Antoni Gaudí's soaring, awe-inspiring basilica combining Gothic and curvilinear Art Nouveau forms.

places.name: Park Güell
places.description: A vibrant garden complex composed of colorful mosaic sculptures, serpentine benches, and panoramic views.

name: Istanbul
tagline: Where East embraces West across the sparkling Bosphorus Strait
description: Spanning Europe and Asia, Istanbul is rich with Ottoman and Byzantine treasures, aromatic spice markets, and majestic domed mosques.

places.name: Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque
places.description: A 6th-century architectural marvel featuring massive marble domes and golden Byzantine mosaics.

places.name: Grand Bazaar
places.description: One of the world's largest covered markets with over 4,000 stalls selling rugs, teas, lanterns, and spices.

name: Cappadocia
tagline: Fairy chimneys, cave hotels, and hot-air balloons at sunrise
description: A surreal moonscape carved by volcanic erosion, dotted with subterranean cities and hundreds of hot-air balloons at golden hour.

places.name: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Flight
places.description: Soar over Göreme Valley at dawn as hundreds of colorful balloons float above ancient cave dwellings.

name: Bali
tagline: Sacred temples, emerald rice terraces, and oceanic wellness
description: Island of the Gods where Hindu spirituality, surf beaches, jungle waterfalls, and organic cafes create a tropical haven.

places.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
places.description: Cascading emerald stepped paddies supported by ancient cooperative subak water management.

places.name: Tanah Lot Sea Temple
places.description: Ancient Hindu shrine perched dramatically on an offshore sea rock surrounded by crashing waves.

name: Singapore
tagline: A futuristic garden city of supertrees, Michelin street food, and wonder
description: A dazzling global metropolis seamlessly blending lush tropical conservatories, luxury marina skylines, and heritage hawker centers.

places.name: Gardens by the Bay
places.description: Solar-powered Supertree structures and the breathtaking indoor waterfall of Cloud Forest Dome.

places.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
places.description: Panoramic observation deck 57 levels above the bay with views across the Singapore Strait.

name: London
tagline: Royal pageantry, West End stages, and centuries of iconic culture
description: From Big Ben and Tower Bridge to world-class free museums, London is a grand historic capital with an electric modern beat.

places.name: Tower Bridge
places.description: Victorian suspension bridge with glass-floor walkways high above the River Thames.

places.name: The British Museum
places.description: A vast collection of world history, art, and antiquities including the Rosetta Stone.

name: Maldives
tagline: Overwater bungalows floating above turquoise coral paradises
description: Over a thousand coral islands in the Indian Ocean, offering the world's most serene overwater villas and vibrant marine life.

places.name: Overwater Bungalows
places.description: Stilted villas directly over translucent lagoons with private ocean stairs and glass flooring.

name: Bangkok & Phuket
tagline: Golden stupas, night markets, and Andaman limestone islands
description: A sensory wonderland of ornate Buddhist temples, buzzing canal boats, street food delicacies, and turquoise island escapes.

places.name: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)
places.description: Stunning riverside spire encrusted with colorful porcelain mosaics rising majestically on the Chao Phraya River.

places.name: Phi Phi Islands
places.description: Sheer limestone cliffs encircling calm azure bays, ideal for snorkelling and island-hopping.

name: Swiss Alps & Interlaken
tagline: Snow-capped Alpine summits, glacial lakes, and storybook chalets
description: The crown jewel of Europe's mountains — ride cogwheel trains up the Jungfraujoch, cruise crystal lakes, and breathe pure Alpine air.

places.name: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
places.description: Europe's highest railway station at 3,454m with access to the Great Aletsch Glacier and ice palace.

name: Tromsø & Fjords
tagline: Northern lights dancing over frozen fjords on the Arctic rim
description: Gateway to the Arctic Circle where deep cobalt fjords meet snowy peaks, offering dog sledding, whale safaris, and aurora borealis.

places.name: Aurora Chasing Expedition
places.description: Venture into Arctic wilderness valleys guided by meteorologists to view ribbons of glowing green aurora.

name: Cairo & Giza
tagline: The Great Pyramids, the Sphinx, and millennia of Pharaonic mystery
description: The cradle of ancient civilization standing beside the Nile, home to the only surviving wonder of the ancient world.

places.name: Great Pyramids & Sphinx of Giza
places.description: 4,500-year-old royal tombs of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure guarded by the enigmatic lion-bodied Sphinx.

name: Tokyo
tagline: The future, the ancient, and everything delicious — simultaneously
description: A hyper-modern megalopolis of neon-lit skyscrapers, tranquil shrines, futuristic digital art, and world-renowned culinary genius.

places.name: Shibuya Crossing
places.description: The world's most choreographed pedestrian intersection, pulsating with Tokyo's kinetic urban energy.

name: New York City
tagline: Eight million stories in the city that never sleeps
description: Broadway theaters, soaring art deco skyscrapers, Central Park greenery, and an unmatched mosaic of international neighborhoods.

places.name: Central Park
places.description: 843 acres of curated woodlands, lakes, and pathways framed by Manhattan's iconic skyline.

name: Cape Town
tagline: Where Table Mountain meets two oceans and coastal vineyards
description: Flat-topped peaks plunging into two oceans, penguin-dotted beaches, award-winning winelands, and vibrant waterfront culture.

places.name: Table Mountain
places.description: Ride a rotating cable car to the flat summit for 360-degree views of the Atlantic and Indian oceans.

name: Dubrovnik
tagline: Pearl of the Adriatic — medieval stone walls and glass-clear seas
description: A pristine walled medieval city rising above the Adriatic, with limestone streets, orange-tiled rooftops, and secluded coves.

places.name: City Walls of Dubrovnik
places.description: 2 kilometers of medieval fortifications offering sweeping coastal panoramas.

name: Machu Picchu
tagline: The Lost City of the Incas, shrouded in Andean mist
description: A 15th-century Inca citadel built high on an Andean mountain ridge, defying gravity and engineering across the centuries.

places.name: Inti Punku (Sun Gate)
places.description: The legendary mountain pass framing the first view of the stone citadel at sunrise.

name: Patagonia
tagline: The edge of the world — glaciers, granite spires, and wild steppe
description: A raw wilderness of jagged granite towers, massive calving blue glaciers, and wind-scoured golden plains.

places.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
places.description: A gargantuan ice wall rising 60m above Lago Argentino with thunderous calving events.

name: Iceland
tagline: Fire, ice, steaming geysers, and auroras on the Arctic frontier
description: A dramatic geological wonderland of erupting volcanoes, black-sand beaches, glacial lagoons, and cascading waterfalls.

places.name: Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon
places.description: Luminous blue icebergs floating quietly from glaciers out to black diamond beaches.

name: Sydney
tagline: Harbour sails, golden surf beaches, and sunlit coastal walks
description: A radiant coastal city famous for the architectural Opera House, Bondi surf culture, and pristine national parks.

places.name: Sydney Opera House
places.description: The world-famous expressionist shell structure presiding over Sydney Harbour.

name: Kathmandu & Pokhara
tagline: Himalayan peaks, serene stupas, and ancient spiritual pathways
description: The rooftop of the world — ancient Newari temples in Durbar Square and peaceful mountain lakes reflecting the Annapurna range.

places.name: Boudhanath Stupa
places.description: One of the largest spherical Buddhist stupas in the world, surrounded by prayer flags and monasteries.

name: Queenstown
tagline: Adventure capital nestled beside crystal Lake Wakatipu
description: Dramatic Remarkables mountain ranges, fjordland cruises, bungee jumping, and pinot noir vineyards on the South Island.

places.name: Milford Sound Fjord
places.description: Described as the eighth wonder of the world with towering Mitre Peak and cascading glacial waterfalls.

name: Marrakech
tagline: A sensory explosion of spice, color, and ancient medina life
description: The 'Red City' whose medina is a labyrinth of souks, riads, and medieval monuments with the Atlas Mountains on the horizon.

places.name: Djemaa el-Fna
places.description: Marrakech's beating heart — storytellers, musicians, and evening grills under glowing lantern smoke.

name: Cancún & Riviera Maya
tagline: Turquoise Caribbean reefs, mystical cenotes, and Mayan pyramids
description: Powder-soft white beaches, crystalline limestone cenote sinkholes, and ancient Mayan ruins overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

places.name: Chichén Itzá Pyramid
places.description: One of the New Seven Wonders of the World, displaying Mayan astronomical and acoustic genius.

name: Amsterdam
tagline: Canals, Golden Age art masterpieces, and cycling culture
description: Concentric rings of historic waterways lined with merchant gables, world-class Van Gogh and Rijksmuseum galleries.

places.name: Canal Ring (Grachtengordel)
places.description: UNESCO-listed waterways best explored by glass-top boat or rented bicycle.

name: Petra
tagline: A rose-red city carved directly into living sandstone cliffs
description: The legendary ancient Nabataean capital hidden deep inside a narrow desert canyon, revealed dramatically through the Siq.

places.name: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury)
places.description: A 43-metre rock-carved Hellenistic façade emerging at the end of the narrow canyon gorge.

name: Rio de Janeiro
tagline: Samba rhythms, golden coastlines, and mountains diving into the sea
description: Dramatic granite peaks overlooking Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, guarded by the iconic open arms of Christ the Redeemer.

places.name: Christ the Redeemer
places.description: The New Wonder of the World atop Corcovado mountain overlooking Guanabara Bay.
